name: claim_succession_containment_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: CLAIM_SUCCESSION_CONTAINMENT_20261104 — a claim succeeds a stale predecessor only when it holds EVERY path the predecessor held (containment), or when the operator of the claim names it explicitly with --takeover; a shared file is never a succession. The suite pins the predicate, the board behaviour, the deduplication and the refusals (unknown / live / disjoint targets). Hermetic: a synthetic board in tmp_path only.
